Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this one-sided game! The action from the Women's World Cup continues on Thursday, 24th March, after a day's break! It will be another double-header! First game of the day will be between South Africa Women and West Indies Women which begins at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous night). The second game of the day sees a clash between England Women and Pakistan Women. This fixture will begin at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT) but you can tune in early for both these games as our build-up will begin much earlier. Cheers!

Mithali Raj, the victorious skipper, says that lack of form is a part and parcel of the game and she also had a similar kind of phase in 2012. Adds that it was important to get partnership on this kind of track and they did well to get to 229, in spite of losing three back-to-back wickets. Tells that having all-rounders helps and it strengthens their batting even more. Says that they have got some quality spinners and this game's surface assisted them a lot. Talking about their next game against South Africa, she says that it will be their first game in Christchurch and they want to do well in all the departments.

Nigar Sultana, the skipper of Bangladesh Women, says that it is very difficult to chase a target like this when the top order doesn't contribute. Tells that the bowlers have been doing well for them and they did put India under pressure. Mentions that Shamima Sultana wasn't playing this game so she kept wickets. Adds that lack of partnerships cost them the game. Says that there were a lot of positives from this game and they look forward to the next game.

Yastika Bhatia is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her knock of 50. She says that she is very pleased but she would have liked more runs for her team. Adds that she has prepared well to bat at number 3 and she has practised hard in the nets. Tells that she bats according to the situation and likes to rotate the strike. Mentions that she takes good care of her diet and says that she is happy to win her first player of match award in the World Cup.
Stay tuned for the presentation....

Batting woes continue for Bangladesh Women! They have been struggling with the bat throughout the tournament. Bangladesh Women lost 5 wickets for just 35 runs inside 20 overs. Salma Khatun and Lata Mondal did show some fighting spirit and scored some runs in the middle, but they perished soon after and could not hold on till the end. Ritu Moni also added some runs at the end and tried to do some sort of damage control. Bangladesh Women will be disappointed with their performance today and will have to come back stronger in their next game.

India Women do have a strong bowling attack and they have proved that yet again. It was a complete team performance from the Women in Blue. All the bowlers were right on cue. Mithali Raj used five bowlers and all of them managed to grab a wicket at least. They were very disciplined with their bowling and they made sure to grab wickets at regular intervals and not let the batters build a partnership. We did see that the pitch started assisting the spinners more in the second innings of the game, which did not help the batters. Sneh Rana was the leader of the pack, she grabbed four wickets in her spell and was economical as well. India Women have managed to grab a total of six points till now and they will gain a lot of confidence after this performance.

India Women win in an emphatic style! It was absolute carnage out there today! Everytime any bowler came on to bowl it looked like they were going to grab a wicket. Bangladesh Women had no answers to India's sensational bowling attack, they were all over the place. Although, they did show some resistance in the middle phase but failed to go on till the end. India Women grab two more vital points and remain in the top four, while Bangladesh Women have lost their fourth game of the competition, and continue to languish at the bottom half of the table.

OUT! TIMBER! That is it! Jhulan Goswami ends Bangladesh's misery! She runs in and serves a yorker, around off. Ritu Moni tries to dig it out but she gets an inside edge which rattles her stumps. Bangladesh Women are bundled out for 119. A thumping win for India Women, they beat Bangladesh Women by 110 runs.

An appeal for LBW...but the umpire says no! Fuller ball, spinning in, outside off. Jahanara Alam walks across leans and looks to defend, but she misses and the ball hits her pads and lobs up towards first slip. They do not opt for a review, since the impact was outside.

Nahida Akter looks to heave it away but it goes off the toe end of the bat, in the air behind the bowler. Sneh Rana backtracks, Pooja Vastrakar runs to her right from mid off and they both collide. Sneh Rana does well to keep her eyes on the ball and she takes it cleanly. Bangladesh Women lose their ninth wicket.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Nahida Akter pushes it to the off side.
Tosses it up, around off. Nahida Akter blocks it.
Flatter ball, spinning in from off. Nahida Akter blocks it.
Nicely tossed up, around leg. Nahida Akter wrists it towards the leg slip fielder.
On a length, around off. Ritu Moni dabs it onto the deck.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Ritu Moni hangs back and defends it.
Floated, outside off. Ritu Moni keeps it out.
Edged but safe! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Ritu Moni reaches out and tries to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes over the slip cordon for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, well outside off. Ritu Moni hangs back and guides it past the gully fielder for a brace.
Tossed up, outside off. Ritu Moni cuts it towards point.
Fuller in length, around off. Nahida Akter prods and keeps it out.

Tosses it up, outside off. Nahida Akter keeps it out.
A quicker ball, around middle. Blocked out.

Review! Fahima Khatun opts for a review as she has been struck on her pad. It looked plumb to the naked eye. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it indicates three reds. Fahima Khatun has to walk back to the hut.

OUT! LBW! Sneh Rana comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway! Bangladesh Women continue to tumble! Sneh Rana gets her third wicket. This was a low full toss, on middle. Fahima Khatun gets down on her knee and looks to sweep this but she misses and gets rapped on her front pad. An appeal for LBW, and the umpire gives it out. Fahima Khatun opts for a review. UltraEdge confirms there was no bat involved and Ball Tracker indicates three reds. Bangladesh Women lose a review and Fahima Khatun has to walk back. India Women inching closer to victory!
Tad shorter, around off, turning in. Fahima Khatun drives it towards cover.

Shorter in length, outside off. Ritu Moni taps it towards point.
Floated, full and around off. Ritu Moni keeps it out.
On a length, around middle. Fahima Khatun tucks it to the leg side and collects a run.
Tosses it up, outside off. Fahima Khatun looks to sweep but she misses.
Flatter ball, outside off. Ritu Moni cuts it towards point and takes a single.
On a length, around middle. Blocked out.
Fahima Khatun walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pooja Vastrakar strikes and gets rid of Lata Mondal who was looking settled at the crease. Pooja Vastrakar gets her second wicket and Bangladesh Women have lost their 7th. A shorter ball, on middle. Lata Mondal hangs back and looks to pull this, but the ball goes off the leading edge and lobs up towards mid-wicket. Harmanpreet Kaur there, backtracks and takes yet another catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Pooja Vastrakar

Angling in, on middle, on a length. Lata Mondal nudges it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Ritu Moni guides it towards third man for a single.
Short again, outside off. Lata Mondal pushes it towards cover.
Fraction shorter now, outside off. Lata Mondal cuts it towards point.
Slower through the air, on middle, fuller ball. Lata Mondal lunges and blocks it out.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Lata Mondal defends it out off the front foot.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Lata Mondal defends it out.
Low full toss, on middle. Lata Mondal sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On a length, darting it on the thigh pads. Lata Mondal works it away towards fine leg for a single. She retains the strike!
Much fuller now, outside off. Lata Mondal presses forward and drives it past cover for a brace.
Angling in, around the thigh pads, on a length. Ritu Moni tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Ritu Moni taps it towards point.

Goswami looks for a yorker but ends up serving a low full toss, around leg. Lata Mondal flicks it behind square on the leg side. Pooja Vastrakar runs across from the deep, puts in a dive to her right and saves a couple of runs for her side. Bangladesh Women need 147 runs off 120 balls.
DRINKS! India Women are on top here, and it's been a struggle for Bangladesh Women. India Women are inching closer to victory they are just 4 wickets away.
Wide! A full ball, spilled down leg. Lata Mondal misses her flick and the umpire calls it wide.
Shorter in length, outside off. Lata Mondal lets it through to the keeper.

Back of a length, well outside off. Ritu Moni throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to make any connection.
Another ball that is full and outside off. Ritu Moni drives it to the cover fielder.
A full ball, around off. Lata Mondal drives it back past the bowler towards mid on for a single.

Floated, full and outside off. Ritu Moni looks to cut but she misses.

This is an overpitched ball, outside off. Ritu Moni drives it through the cover region and takes a couple of runs.
Tossed up ball, around off and spinning away late. Ritu Moni looks to drive but the ball beats her outside edge.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad (7-4-6-1) is back on!
An appeal for LBW but turned down! A yorker-length ball, angling in from middle. Lata Mondal fails to dig it out and gets hit low on her pad.
Back of a length, outside off. Ritu cuts it towards backward point for a run.
Ritu Moni walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Change of pace and some extra bounce brings about the downfall of Salma Khatun! Brilliant bowling by Goswami! She serves an off-cutter that lands on a length, just outside off. Salma Khatun hangs back and looks to guide it towards third man. The ball takes off from a length, ricochets off her gloves and goes straight to Richa Ghosh behind the sticks who takes a sitter. Bangladesh Women lose their sixth wicket. End of a gutsy innings from Salma!
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Jhulan Goswami

A low full toss, outside off. Salma Khatun drags it towards mid off. Bangladesh Women need 157 runs off 144 balls.

Back of a length, outside off. Salma Khatun dabs it towards backward point.

Flighted delivery again, around middle. Salma Khatun tucks it towards square leg.

Flatter ball, quicker, around leg. Lata Mondal flicks it towards fine leg for a single.

NOT OUT! On a length, shaping away outside off. Lata Mondal swings her bat, but she misses. Richa Ghosh collects the and hits the stumps directly at the striker's end. The replay shows, Lata Mondal's foot was just inside the crease. Not out is the decision!

Fuller delivery, around middle. Lata Mondal flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.

Tossed up, outside off. Salma Khatun leaves it alone.

Review! India Women opt for a review as Salma Khatun has been struck on her pad. Was there any bat involved? No, says the UltraEdge! The Ball Tracker shows that the ball would have just clipped the leg stump and it is umpire's call on wickets hitting.

NOT OUT! A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! This one comes in with the angle, fuller ball, around middle. Salma Khatun presses forward and looks to block this but she gets beaten on the inside edge and gets rapped on the front pad. India Women opts for a review! No bat involved, confirms the UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows it was the umpire's call on wickets hitting! The on-field decision stands.
Full again, outside off. Salma Khatun lets it go through.
Fuller ball, outside off, spinning away. Salma Khatun leaves it alone.
Shorter ball again, outside off. Salma Khatun steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Lata Mondal pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery, around off. Lata Mondal drives it towards Yastika Bhatia at cover.
On a length, outside off. Salma Khatun pushes it towards third man for a single.
Shorter ball, down leg. Lata Mondal pulls it towards square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Salma Khatun dabs it towards third man for a single.

Slower through the air, on a length, around off. Salma Khatun pushes it back to the bowler, on the bounce. A productive over for Bangladesh Women!

Salma plays another reverse-sweep but this time she does not time it that well. The fielder at short third man cuts it off and the batters take two runs.
Floated, on a length, outside off. Salma Khatun leaves it alone.
A googly, on a length, around off. Salma Khatun keeps it out.
FOUR! Innovation from Salma Khatun and she has come out with intent here! A loopy ball, full and around off. Salma kneels and reverse-sweeps it through the third man region for a boundary.
A full ball, outside off. Lata Mondal defends it to the off side.
Lata sweeps this full ball yet again through mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, outside off and spinning in late. Lata Mondal looks to drive but she gets a thick inside edge which goes past the leg stump.
Tossed up, on off. Salma Khatun sweeps it through mid-wicket and the batters collect three runs in total.
Salma Khatun comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another brilliant review from India and Bangladesh Women lose their fifth wicket now! Spin is doing the trick for India Women at the moment and Bangladesh are losing their way out! Rana serves a flatter ball that lands on a length and spins in late. Rumana Ahmed goes back in her crease and tries to wrist it towards the leg side. She gets a glove on it and the ball goes towards Yastika Bhatia at short leg who grabs the ball. India Women appeal but the umpire says no. Mithali Raj opts for a review and the UltraEdge confirms that were was some glove on it before it went to the fielder. The on-field decision is overturned!
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Review! India Women have reviewed a decision for a catch at short leg. UltraEdge confirms the ball did come off the glove and another successful review for India Women
Flatter ball, outside off and turning in late. Rumana Ahmed keeps it out.
In the air but safe! Slower through the air, full and outside off. Lata Mondal prods and pushes it uppishly towards the short cover fielder. The ball lands just in front of Yastika Bhatia there.
Tossed up, around off. Lata Mondal keeps it out.

Lata Mondal comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A soft dismissal and Poonam Yadav gets her first wicket of this World Cup! She tosses it up, outside off. Murshida Khatun prods and looks to go over cover. She toe-ends it straight towards Harmanpreet Kaur at extra cover who takes a juggling catch. Bangladesh Women slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Poonam Yadav

Tossed up, on off. Murshida Khatun keeps it out.
Shorter in length, outside off. Murshida Khatun cuts it to deep cover for a run.
This is served wider of off. Murshida Khatun reaches out and looks to go over cover but she fails to make any connection.
On a length, around off. Murshida Khatun keeps it out.

Another floated delivery, around off. Rumana Ahmed has blocked this one off the front foot.
Spinning away, fuller again, loopy ball. Rumana Ahmed blocks it out.

Fuller ball, slower through the air, outside off, spinning away. Murshida Khatun leaves it alone. End of a successful over by Sneh Rana!

DRINKS! India Women are all over Bangladesh Women at the moment! Bangladesh need a big partnership here to get back in this contest and things are getting difficult for them as the pitch is turning a lot. India Women will be looking to chip away with wickets and maintain the pressure on their opposition. Rumana Ahmed walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A well-deserved wicket for Sneh Rana! She has been causing problems and now she has been rewarded with the wicket of Nigar Sultana! But she miscues her shot as the ball goes off the toe-end towards Harmanpreet Kaur at mid on who takes an easy catch. Bangladesh Women are in a spot of bother now!
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Sneh Rana

Yorker-length delivery, on middle. Murshida Khatun pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, fuller ball. Murshida Khatun leaves it alone.

Fuller ball, outside off. Murshida Khatun pushes it towards cover.
Outside off, spinning away. Murshida Khatun leaves it alone.

Is that a run out? A direct hit at the bowler's end and Murshida Khatun might be in trouble. The replays show that she had made it home.
A full toss, on middle. Nigar Sultana works it away past square leg for a single.
Fullish ball again, outside off. Nigar Sultana drives it towards cover.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nigar Sultana leans and defends it out.
Well bowled! Right in the blockhole! Yorker-length delivery, around middle and off. Nigar Sultana squeezes it out towards point.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a total of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over!
Flatter ball, outside off. Murshida Khatun stays back to cut but she fails to get any blade on it.

In the air...but it lands just in front of the point fielder. Absolute chaos out in the middle. Rana bowls it slower through the air, full and outside off. Murshida Khatun looks to drive on the up but it goes off the outer  half of the bat and falls just short of Rajeshwari Gayakwad at backward point who dives forward to grab it. The ball goes past her and Poonam Yadav cuts it off. The batters look for the second run but the throw is at the wrong end towards the keeper. Richa Ghosh collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but she misses and Nigar Sultana survives.
Tossed up delivery, around off and turning away late. Murshida Khatun gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Floated, full and on off. Murshida Khatun keeps it out.
Shorter in length, outside off. Murshida Khatun cuts it wide of deep cover and takes a couple of runs.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Murshida Khatun looks to cut but she misses.
Sneh Rana comes into the attack.
A full ball, on middle. Nigar Sultana keeps it out.
Nigar Sultana comes to the crease now.

Review! India Women have reviewed an LBW decision against Fargana Hoque. No bat involved, confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker indicated three reds. A successful review by India Women! The on-field decision has to be overturned.

OUT! LBW! Excellent review from India! Pooja Vastrakar strikes in her very first over and she was absolutely convinced that she had got rid of Fargana Hoque here! She also managed to convince Mithali Raj to opt for a review. Pooja serves a very full ball that is angling back in from middle. Fargana Hoque prods and looks to play it across the line. She misses and gets hit low on her pad. India Women appeal but the umpire says no. They take a review and the Ball Tracker indicates three reds. Fargana Hoque is a goner! India Women retain their review. Bangladesh Women are in trouble.
Full and outside off. Fargana Hoque drives but straight to the cover fielder.
On a length and angling in from middle. Fargana Hoque tucks it to mid-wicket.
Good running between the wickets! Good-length ball, around off. Murshida Khatun taps it towards cover and puts in a dive at the non-striker's end to complete a run.
Pooja starts with a length ball, around off. Murshida Khatun defends it solidly off the back foot.
Pooja Vastrakar comes into the attack now.
Turn again! This lands on a length, around off and spinning away late. Fargana Hoque gets forward to defend but the ball goes past her blade.

Bye! Top delivery from Rajeshwari Gayakwad, she gets sharp turn on this one! Floated, full and outside off. Murshida Khatun prods to drive but the ball spins in and sneaks through the gap between her bat and pad. Richa Ghosh fails to grab it cleanly and the batters take a bye.
This is on a length and spinning in from off. Murshida Khatun hangs back and defends it onto the deck.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Murshida Khatun stays back and looks to cut it late but the ball beats her outside edge.
Floated, full and outside off. Murshida Khatun gets to the pitch of the ball and keeps it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Murshida Khatun stays back and cuts it towards cover.
Goswami goes full and around off. Fargana Hoque prods and pushes it towards mid off. Just 1 run off it. Top start for India Women!
Good-length delivery, well outside off. Fargana Hoque looks to cut hard but she misses.
Murshida Khatun skips down the track and Goswami follows her with a full ball, outside off. It goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Murshida Khatun taps it to point.
Back of a length, around off. Murshida Khatun dabs it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, around off. Murshida Khatun keeps it out.
Around off, blocked out. A wicket-maiden from Rajeshwari Gayakwad!
Sharp turn! This is a quicker ball, on a length, outside off and turning away sharply. Fargana Hoque looks to poke at it at first but sways away from the line in the end.
A bit quicker, on a length, around middle. Fargana Hoque defends it to the on side.
Floated, on off. Fargana Hoque prods and defends it.
Tossed up, on middle. Fargana Hoque keeps it out.
Fargana Hoque comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rajeshwari Gayakwad gets the breakthrough and Bangladesh Women lose a wicket early on! Lovely bowling from the spinner and she deserved this wicket. Gayakwad tosses this one up, outside off and turning away a bit. Sharmin Akhter looks to drive but she gets an outside edge. The ball ricochets off Richa Ghosh's gloves and lobs up in the air towards first slip. Sneh Rana there takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Rajeshwari Gayakwad

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around middle. Murshida Khatun looks to push this away but she manages to get an inside edge onto her pads.
Fullish ball, around off. Murshida Khatun defends it out.

SIX! up and over! Top shot from Murshida Khatun. This was full, wide of off. Murshida Khatun waits in her crease and carves it over cover for a biggie. This is the first six hit by Bangladesh Women in Women's World Cup.
Good fielding! Fuller now, outside off. Murshida Khatun drives it towards cover. Yastika Bhatia there dives towards her left and makes a good stop.
Fuller now, around middle. Murshida Khatun looks to drive this but she gets an inside edge on to her pads.
On a length, around middle. Murshida Khatun defends it out off the back foot.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Sharmin Akhter presses forward and defends it out solidly.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Sharmin Akhter lunges and blocks it out.
Full again, outside off. Sharmin Akhter drives it towards cover. The fielder there fails to stop the ball and the batters take two runs.
Fuller now, outside off. Sharmin Akhter defends it out.
Beaten! Some turn now! A fuller ball, slower through the air, spins away, outside off. Sharmin Akhter leans to block this but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Sharmin Akhter defends it out.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Sharmin Akhter shuffles across and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Angling in, around middle. Sharmin Akhter looks to tuck this away, but she misses and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter drives it towards mid off.
Another length delivery, wide of off. Sharmin Akhter once again looks to chop this one, but she fails to get any bat on it again.
Beaten! Shorter ball, outside off. Sharmin Akhter stays in her crease and looks to cut this but she misses.
On a length, around middle. Sharmin Akhter works it away towards mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, full, down leg. Sharmin Akhter sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single. 3 runs off Rajeshwari Gayakwad's first over!
Leg bye! Loopy ball, full, around middle and leg. Murshida Khatun looks to flick this but she misses. The ball brushes off her pads and rolls towards fine leg. Leg bye taken!
Tad shorter, outside off. Murshida Khatun pushes it towards cover.
Fuller now, around middle. Sharmin Akhter sweeps it towards fine leg for a single. Bangladesh Women and Sharmin Akhter are up and running!
Quicker, flatter, around middle. Sharmin Akhter blocks it out.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! This one comes in with the arm, on the pads. Sharmin Akhter looks to flick this but she misses and gets rapped on her pads. That might be sliding down leg.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad will operate from the other end.
Jhulan Goswami starts with a maiden over! Another length delivery, around off. Murshida Khatun punches it off the back foot towards cover.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Murshida Khatun taps it towards cover once again. No run take!

Full, outside off, Murshida drives it towards cover. She wanders around for a single but Pooja Vastrakar is quick to get to the ball to keep the batter honest and back in her crease. Wait, oh gosh, poor Ghosh. There is more. Vastrakar returns a simple throw to Richa Ghosh on the bounce as she comes running in to collect but the ball lands besides the pitch and then shoots up, nearly taking her head off! Wait wait, there is even more. Harmanpreet Kaur is fielding at short mid-wicket and she runs across to her left to back up the throw by Pooja as Ghosh did not collect that, swaying away from the line. But at the same time, Sneh Rana is charging to her right from short fine leg to collect that same throw. Bang. Kaur rams into Rana, knocks her down and herself tumbles over. After all this, it is a plain dot ball!
Much fuller on this occasion, around off. Murshida Khatun drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Murshida Khatun taps it towards cover again.
Jhulan Goswami begins with a length ball, outside off. Murshida Khatun stays back and defends it towards cover.
